@deskTfOpenTitle.description: Row title in the Transaction files card on Receive: one Open button for every kind of transaction file.

deskTfOpenText: Choose one file or several. The wallet reads each one and signs, finishes or posts it.

@deskTfOpenText.description: Row text under Open transaction files: the wallet works out what each file is and does that step.

deskTfDropHint: You can also drop them here.

@deskTfDropHint.description: Added after the Open transaction files row text in the desktop apps: files can be dragged onto the card.

@deskTfPickTitle.description: Title of the system file dialog opened by Open transaction files (several files can be chosen).

@deskTfResults.description: Screen-reader label of the list of results, one line per file opened.

@deskTfWorking.description: Result line of a file the wallet is still reading, signing or posting.

@deskTfSigned.description: Result line of a sender's file: signed, and the response file written. {path} is where it was saved.

@deskTfAlreadyPosted.description: Result line of a finished payment this wallet already shows as posted: nothing was sent again.

deskTfInvoice: An invoice for {amount}. Review it to pay.

@deskTfInvoice.description: Result line of a payment request (invoice) file: it is not paid until the user reviews it. {amount} is the amount with its unit.

@deskTfReview.description: Button on an invoice's result line: opens its review.

@deskTfCreate.description: Quiet button in the Transaction files card's heading: opens Send to pay with a file.
